notes.title: Restart
notes.notes:
Follow my current game here: [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/2998700/Playable_Alpha/]Playable Alpha[/url]

Couple months and a lot of work later, I decide to pull the plug on Astromart Adventures.
The game was fun, for 1h, after that it became just a chore.
Creating minigame after minigame is just such a waste of time, the return as a player was just not worth it.

I value your time, and the original concept did not, at all, to my liking.

So I alt+f4 the project and started fresh.

Inspired by Fallout it should be more of a looter shooter where you can upgrade your weapons, gear, and just have fun.
The setting is supposed to be Germany and hopefully each location will tell a story.

notes.title: Log #1
notes.notes:
Here we are, on Steam, making a cute little game.
I would be happy if you can join me on that adventure.
Maybe a cool game comes out at the end.

What is working so far:
[list]
[*] Customers will browse stroll destinations to make the market area look alive
[*] Customers will grab a free checkout and present you with their wishes if available
[*] Once the customer has all it wants, it will dance, walk to its space ship and leave, a new customer will spawn
[*] Saving furniture, like shelves, checkouts etc.
[*] Saving shelf content
[*] Saving clutter items, stuff that the player grabbed and is laying somewhere
[*] VR player control: hands, interaction, custom poses for items (so the hand grabs them in a nice position)
[*] Saving player position and stats (credits, health)
[*] Merchant area with items to buy
[*] Being able to grab items like shelves and place them, no grid
[*] An elevator to get you down in to the asteroid and all its mechanics: calling an elevator, pushing a trigger inside it, not falling out
[*] Rocks: Harvested items, rocks, spawn into clutter items and will be saved accordingly
[*] Player: Can walk, run, crouch, reset height (reset rotation not working yet)
[/list]
All in all the core shopping part works and just needs more content.
Customers themselves or not being saved as they have way too many parameters. To do: Have items that are in the basket respawn somewhere so they are not lost if you quit the game.
